auth.setup.closed.text: The app is already set up. Sign in instead.
auth.setup.closed.description: Error shown when setup is submitted after an account already exists, for example by two people at once.

auth.setup.intro.text: Create the first account. It will be the administrator of the app.

auth.setup.submit.description: Button that submits the setup form and creates the administrator account.

auth.setup.title.description: Heading and page title of the first-run setup page, where the first administrator account is created.

auth.sign_in.invalid.description: Error shown on the sign-in page when the username or the password is wrong; it never says which.

auth.sign_in.locked.text: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.sign_in.locked.description: Error shown on the sign-in page while the account or device is locked after repeated failed attempts. {minutes} is the whole number of minutes until the lock ends.

auth.sign_in.submit.description: Button that submits the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.title.description: Heading and page title of the sign-in page.

auth.sign_out.description: Button that ends the current session.

errors.not_allowed.text: You're not allowed to see this page.
errors.not_allowed.description: Heading and page title shown when the user may not open a page or the record doesn't exist; it never says which.

errors.page_not_found.description: Heading and page title shown when the address doesn't match any page of the app.

errors.unexpected.text: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unexpected.description: Heading and page title shown when an unexpected error stops a page from loading.

offline.message.text: Reconnect to the internet to continue.

offline.title.description: Heading and page title of the page shown when the app is opened without a network connection.

settings.title.description: Heading and page title of the administrators' settings page.

settings.version.description: Line on the settings page showing the installed app version; {version} is a version number such as 0.1.0.

shell.home.title.description: Heading of the home page shown after signing in.

shell.nav.home.description: Navigation link to the home page.

shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the main navigation, read by screen readers as "Main navigation".

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation link to the administrators' settings page.

shell.skip_to_content.description: Link at the very top of every signed-in page, visible when focused with the keyboard, that jumps past the navigation.

shell.user_menu.profile.description: Link in the user menu to the user's own profile page.

users.display_name.control_characters.text: The name contains characters that are not allowed.
users.display_name.control_characters.description: Error under the display name field when it contains invisible control characters.

users.display_name.empty.description: Error under the display name field when it is empty.

users.display_name.too_long.description: Error under the display name field when it is longer than 64 characters.

users.field.display_name.description: Label of the field for the name shown to other household members.

users.field.language.description: Label of the language selector on the profile page.

users.field.time_zone.description: Label of the time zone selector on the profile page.

users.field.username.description: Label of the username field, used to sign in.

users.locale.not_installed.text: Choose one of the available languages.
users.locale.not_installed.description: Error under the language field when the chosen language is not installed.

users.password.length.description: Error under the password field when the password is too short or too long.

users.profile.browser_default.description: First option of the language selector: follow the language of the browser in use.

users.profile.intro.text: Your language and time zone apply on every device you sign in from.

users.profile.save.description: Button that saves the profile settings.

users.profile.title.description: Heading and page title of the user's own profile page.

users.time_zone.invalid.description: Error under the time zone field when the value is not a known time zone.

users.username.invalid.text: Use 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters a-z, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
users.username.invalid.description: Error under the username field when it breaks the username rules.

users.username.taken.text: That username is already in use.
users.username.taken.description: Error under the username field when another account already has it.

validation.invalid.description: Generic error under a form field whose value is not valid.
